SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.product_id = #{productId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id = 0
AND c.rating >= 4
AND c.rating = 3
AND c.rating >= 1 AND c.rating <= 2
AND c.images IS NOT NULL AND c.images != ''
ORDER BY
c.like_count DESC, c.create_time DESC c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id IN #{pid} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM product_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND parent_id = 0 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND rating > 0 GROUP BY rating
SELECT images FROM product_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND parent_id = 0 AND images IS NOT NULL AND images != '' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND parent_id = 0 AND images IS NOT NULL AND images != ''
SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id IN #{uid} AND oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.order_status IN (1, 2, 3)
